items.must_not: Do not generalize beyond two quarters, wage earners, or EPH's 32 urban agglomerates; do not present as a finding about total informality or as stability of the labour market; do not upgrade or reverse by cross-regime inference.
items.what_is_preserved: The weighted share of EPH wage/salary earners without a reported pension-fund deduction moved from 36.29% (2025-Q1) to 37.90% (2026-Q1), +1.61 percentage points, within LAB-HYP-0003's 5-point threshold: its FAILURE_CONDITION is met on this two-quarter, single-root test.
items.what_would_unseat: A demonstrated error in this session's own EPH retrieval/hash (LAB-A2/LAB-A2.1), a demonstrated error in the PONDERA-weighted computation, or a future quarter showing the shift crossing the 5-percentage-point threshold when added to this two-point series.

items.must_not: Do not soften, omit, or convert into a negative finding or a positive finding; the result is absence of evidence within the evaluated scope. Do not report a causal effect of Monotributo threshold changes in either direction.
items.what_is_preserved: LAB-HYP-0006's pre-registered design is not computable from admitted or plausibly admissible sources: (1) ARCA data is stock, not flow; (2) the only EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP source (MLER) ends 2021-12; (3) no source links a person across tax-registration and employment records. No causal effect was computed and no proxy was substituted.
items.what_would_unseat: Discovery and governed admission of a genuinely new official source with individual-level or flow/transition data linking tax registration to employment status, covering a period overlapping an admissible episode -- not pursued or expected based on this project's own repeated prior investigation.

items.must_not: Do not soften, omit, or convert into a negative finding or a positive finding; the result is absence of evidence within the evaluated scope. Do not restate as 'no source exists'; the conclusion is scoped to the evaluated criteria. Do not read as a finding about recruitment or selection processes.
items.what_is_preserved: No admissible Job Posting Observatory source was identified within the scope and criteria evaluated across two bounded rounds (eight candidates plus one ownership-check bundle). Zero postings were captured.
items.what_would_unseat: Discovery and governed evaluation of a genuinely new candidate not considered in LAB-C1 or LAB-C1.1 (e.g. a sector-specific Argentine board, an employer-side ATS with a public research feed, or a future official open dataset of individual job postings), or a material change in an already-evaluated candidate's own Terms of Service, robots.txt, or API offering (e.g. a private board publishing a public research-scoped API, or the Cartelera Publica moving its convocatorias to a non-PDF, robots.txt-permitted format) -- none of which is pursued or expected by this claim.

items.must_not: Do not soften, omit, or convert into a negative finding or a positive finding; the result is absence of evidence within the evaluated scope. Do not upgrade to NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; do not measure or imply a postings-versus-hires divergence; do not treat employment stocks as hires.
items.what_is_preserved: There is not sufficient evidence, within the sources and scope evaluated, to compare postings with real hiring outcomes: no admissible postings corpus, no admitted HIRE-event source, and no validated linkage. Deliberately not NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.
items.what_would_unseat: Governed admission of an admissible JOB_POSTING corpus together with an independent source of HIRE events (transition or flow data, not employment stocks) and a validated linkage or taxonomy connecting them -- none of which is pursued or expected by this claim, and each of which would require its own separately authorized admission.

items.must_not: Do not infer contractorization or economic dependence from registration categories or from the unvalidated PP05F proxy; do not drop for lack of a claim record.
items.what_is_preserved: Distinguishing real independent provision from disguised dependent employment is terminally NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: no admitted or plausibly admissible source carries ground-truth dependence labels. No claim exists; the outcome lives in the question ledger.

items.must_not: Do not describe as a negative search result or as evidence about AI use in hiring; posting silence about AI does not mean AI was not used.
items.what_is_preserved: AI-in-hiring prevalence by taxonomy category is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE by design (a designed terminal state). No search for an AI-disclosure mechanism was ever conducted; LAB-C2 was disposed without execution. No claim exists.

items.must_not: Do not estimate or imply ghosting prevalence from any source; do not use postings data as a proxy.
items.what_is_preserved: Population-level ghosting is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: it is observable only from the candidate side and no representative candidate-side sampling frame is known. No claim exists.

items.must_not: Do not answer this question by juxtaposing SIPA/CGI/MLER claims with EPH claims; do not invent a metric inside LAB-S.
items.what_is_preserved: Divergence between administrative sources and household surveys was never executed: no METRIC, EXPECTED_OBSERVATION, or FAILURE_CONDITION was ever pre-registered, and inventing one afterwards was refused. A design gap, not a data gap.

items.must_not: Do not attribute causes to any observed change in composition or share; do not treat any descriptive claim as causal.
items.what_is_preserved: Whether formalization policy causally affects the registered-employment share was never executed: it is CAUSAL, CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION_STATUS is NO_DESIGN, and it was outside Regime A's remit. No claim exists.

items.must_not: Do not present the selected episode as evidence of an effect; do not report any causal estimate.
items.what_is_preserved: The causal question on Monotributo threshold changes stays open: CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION_STATUS is CANDIDATE_DESIGN, an episode (EP-2025-AUG, 2025-08-01) was selected under LAB-GOV-Q0013-EPISODE-SELECTION-0001, and no causal effect was ever computed. See KEEP-002.
